name: jev-model-router
description: Picks the session model (haiku/sonnet/opus) from the first prompt of a fresh context, using the JEV decision model

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: Key for the JEV decision model. Kept in secure storage. Leave empty to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment.

allowHaiku.title: Route down to Haiku
allowHaiku.description: Off: JEV picks only between Sonnet and Opus.

haikuConfidence.title: Haiku confidence bar
haikuConfidence.description: JEV must be at least this sure (0-1) before downgrading to Haiku; below it the session gets Sonnet. A wrong downgrade costs more than a wrong upgrade.
